name: 放松交流与信任 · V1

parameters.prompt: Original instrumental underscore for a contemporary mature werewolf romance, intimate and restrained rather than epic or horror. D minor, 60 BPM, 4/4. Shared recurring four-note leitmotif D-F-E-A with spacious rests, one quiet statement every four bars. Low cello, sparse felt piano, delicate electronic pulse; leave room for a low male speaking voice. Clean studio music only: no voices, breathing, choir, environmental sound, risers or impacts. A seamless 9-bar 36-second bed. Warm intimate felt piano clearly states the same D-F-E-A motif sparsely, gentle sustained strings, D minor add9 moving through Bbmaj7 and Fadd9 with restrained hopeful warmth. Tender relief and equal mutual trust, no melodramatic climax. Stable calm dynamics, no intro/outro, continuous texture through boundaries.
